news.title: Two New Papers
news.body: Added HARMONY for single-image scene reconstruction and VibeWorlding for 3D world construction.

news.title: Research Map & README Refresh
news.body: Separated interaction from streaming delivery; narrowed executable verification to methods, with benchmarks indexed by task. Refreshed the visual research map and compact reading index. All 58 records are retained.

news.title: Benchmark Atlas & Infrastructure
news.body: Added 14 works, including 4DCodeBench, BVB, BlenderWorld, PhysCodeGym, PhySimCode, ExeWorldBench, WorldStream and H3 Streaming VAE Decoder. Named benchmark suites now have task, artifact and evaluation indexes; 3DCodeVerse data and harness resources are linked.

news.title: Initial Collection
news.body: 44 papers and projects covering Code World Model (generation) and Code as Model (understanding), including earlier foundations and the latest October releases.

news.title: Research Taxonomy
news.body: Nine core research categories, two related perspectives, and seven comparison dimensions. Representative works are highlighted with 🌟.

news.title: Daily Discovery Prototype
news.body: Daily arXiv and GitHub discovery is implemented as a candidate-review workflow. Automated promotion and a full literature-review agent remain future work.
